submitted.rationale: I used all 3 merit measurements. I started near BiVO4, with Bi about equal to V, and moved toward more Fe. Photocurrent went up as Fe increased: idx35 (Fe 0.16) gave 7.06e-6 A, idx57 (Fe 0.35) gave 7.96e-6 A and idx62 (Bi0.27 Fe0.38 V0.35) gave 1.236e-5 A. idx62 is the highest measured.

rejected.reason: The GP suggested it, but its predicted mean was only about 5e-6 A, in a lower-Fe region that was trending worse
